desc: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that the 19th Annual General Meeting ('AGM') of the Members of Stanley Lifestyles Limited will be held on Monday, September 28, 2026 at 2:30 PM IST through Video Conferencing ('VC') / Other Audio-Visual Means ('OAVM'), to transact the businesses as set out in the Notice of AGM.

Pursuant to Regulation 34(1) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby submit the Annual Report of Stanley Lifestyles Limited for the financial year 2025-26, along with the Notice convening the 19th Annual General Meeting ('AGM') scheduled to be held on Monday, September 28, 2026 at 2:30 PM IST through Video Conferencing ('VC') / Other Audio-Visual Means ('OAVM').

Pursuant to Regulation 34(2)(f) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby submit the Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR) of Stanley Lifestyles Limited for the financial year 2025-26, which forms part of the Annual Report of the Company.
